description: This file defines API endpoints for shopping cart operations in a FastAPI application, including retrieving, adding, updating, and removing cart items. It uses dependency injection for database session and current customer information, and interacts with a CartService to perform business logic.

methods.name: CartResponse get_cart( current_customer: Customer = Depends(get_current_customer), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Retrieve the current customer's shopping cart with totals.

methods.name: CartItemAddResponse add_to_cart( item: CartItemCreate, current_customer: Customer = Depends(get_current_customer), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Add an item to the customer's cart or increment quantity if it already exists.

methods.name: CartUpdateResponse update_cart_item( cart_id: int, update_data: CartItemUpdate, current_customer: Customer = Depends(get_current_customer), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Update the quantity of a specific cart item.

methods.name: CartDeleteResponse remove_from_cart( cart_id: int, current_customer: Customer = Depends(get_current_customer), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Remove a specific item from the customer's cart.
